senses.gloss: m. ch. (= h. אוֹנֶס, v. foreg.) force, wrong, robbery; accident.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 31:12">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXI, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 34a:13">Git. 34ᵃ</cite>. <he>אי משום א׳</he> shall we take into consideration the possibility of an unavoidable accident?—Pl. <he>אוֹנְסַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 27b:3">Ned. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמיגליא</he> (read <he>דמיגליי</he>, Rashi <he>אונסא</he>) accidents which may be foreseen.
